notes:
Sales/technical notes: 
- Primary pain: current Elastic+custom reranker can't scale to 18M docs without large infra costs; latency spikes during business hours.
- Objective: migrate embeddings + reranker to reduce cost per query ~30% while meeting quality SLAs.
- POC scope: embedding reindex of 18M docs (approx), run offline evals on historical queries (5k labeled), then live A/B (canary -> ramp) for reranker.
- Quality bar: "cannot accept >1% drop in NDCG@10" — quoted from Head of Search.
- Operational constraints: must support VPC deployment and customer-managed KMS; audit logs required for all inference calls.
- Routing/fallback requirement: automatic fallback to legacy reranker or smaller model when latency > threshold.
- Cost constraints: CFO wants cost-per-query model; must provide 12-month TCO comparison vs self-hosting.
- Evals plan:="run automated evals harness (provided by Redwood Optimize) with per-prompt scoring + regression alerts; define pass/fail gates for canary (NDCG, MRR, token-cost delta, latency P95)".
- Quote from SE: "We should treat reranker migration as a metrics-driven rollout; pin config and use A/B with nightly offline evals."
- Risks: dataset drift on some query types (long-tail legal docs), need to tune embedding dimension/quantization to hit latency goals.
- Next steps (from last call): AE to push revised pricing deck; SE to prepare canary test harness and evaluation dashboards; security to review Dedicated architecture doc.
- Stubs/refs: Drive: embedding_benchmarks.xlsx; Fireflies ff-20260218 link for tech call; Jira INF-4589 for initial infra request.
